S1214.reason: Under VCLT Article 7, heads of State, heads of government and foreign ministers are presumed to conclude treaties without full powers, and heads of mission are presumed to adopt the treaty text.

S0587.reason: Universal jurisdiction lets every State prosecute a defined set of grave crimes regardless of territory or nationality.

S1059.reason: In inter-State arbitration the parties appoint the members of the tribunal, including agreement on the presiding arbitrator.
